instantiated_cells.justification: Section 1-o establishes criminal penalties (class A misdemeanor; class E felony for repeat offenses) and civil penalties for knowingly and willfully failing to timely file required lobbying reports/statements or filing false information or violating the gift ban.

Section 1-d(b) authorizes a program of random audits and requires the commission to contract with an outside accounting entity to monitor and certify the random audit selection and process, establishing regular auditing with third-party oversight.
